speech_text:
Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 22 at 1:11PM PDT until October 22 at 1:15PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV.

The storm which prompted the warning has moved out of the area. Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire. However, small hail, gusty winds, and heavy rain are still possible with this thunderstorm.
